Loading

Introduction

Use the loading icon to present a transition state during loading.

Sample Code

Loading type

<maui-loading type="spinner" />

Custom color

<maui-loading color="#1989fa" /> <maui-loading type="spinner" color="#1989fa" />

Loading copywriting

<maui-loading size="24px">Loading...</maui-loading>

Vertically arranged

<maui-loading size="24px" vertical="true">Loading...</maui-loading>

API

Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
color Color String #c9c9c9
type Type. The value can be spinner. String circular
size Size of the loading icon, in pixels. String | Number 30px
text-size Text size, in pixels. String | Number 14px
vertical Whether to vertically arrange icons and text. Boolean false

Slots

Name Description
- Loading copywriting.
